turns.text: I dislocated my shoulder playing football and it's clearly out of the socket. I'm heading to A&E but the wait will be hours. How do I get through them?
Why can't it just be popped back in by anyone? What's the risk?
How do I support the arm — sling, pillow, what position?
If I could get a triage nurse's attention, what should I tell them?
What do emergency doctors do before they put it back — X-rays, painkillers?
A friend said ice in a tea towel for twenty minutes at a time. Right?
Someone else told me not to eat in case they need to sedate me. Is that true?
The pain is unbearable and the waiting room is chaos. What painkillers can I safely take while I wait?
What signs would mean I need to push to be seen faster — numbness, colour changes?
Can you give me a plan for the next few hours — support, ice, painkillers, position, and what to say at triage?
